## Function Transaction Deck

The mark an --only cut puts on every acceptance, and the test whether a deck carries it.

Behaviour: src/cards/transaction.ts (P21c, issue #12), pure, no import but the Card type: `export const TRANSACTION_MARK = "# morph: subset transaction"` (a shell comment line) and isTransactionDeck(cards) — true when some card's acceptance is a string starting with TRANSACTION_MARK + "\n", else false (an empty list included). The mark is written by Build Acceptances for an --only cut and read by Run Deck (the deck runs as one transaction) and Stub Trees (the tree of the whole subset).

Steps:
- reads: Card

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given cards [a with acceptance TRANSACTION_MARK + "\nexit 0", b with acceptance null]; then [a "exit 0", b null]; then []; when isTransactionDeck; then true; false; false
2. given one card whose acceptance is TRANSACTION_MARK alone (no newline); then " " + TRANSACTION_MARK + "\nexit 0"; then "exit 0\n" + TRANSACTION_MARK + "\n"; when isTransactionDeck; then false; false; false (only a first line equal to the mark counts)

## Function Blame Log

The cards a red acceptance log blames by the files its lines name, and the lines naming files outside them.

Behaviour: blameLog(log, card, owners, fileLines, exists) in src/cards/transaction.ts, pure: log the red acceptance's output; card the customId whose acceptance it is; owners a Record target path → owning customId; fileLines regular-expression sources (Tree Profiles' fileLine, in order: group 1 the path, group 2 the rest); exists(path) whether the path is on disk. For every line of log.split("\n"), its trailing white space removed (trimEnd): a line that is "" or starts with "#", " " or "\t" is skipped; else the FIRST of fileLines (new RegExp, in order) that matches it gives p = group 1 and rest = group 2 (none matches → the line is ignored); p an own key of owners → owners[p] is blamed; else exists(p) false → card is blamed (a file of the acceptance itself, gone when it ends: a probe); else p + rest is an outside line. No line matched any of fileLines → card is blamed. → Blame {cards: the blamed ids, outside: the outside lines}, each once, sorted (JavaScript's default sort). The inputs are never changed.

- produces: Blame

## Function Build Acceptances

Sets the acceptance of every card the checks name, from its generation's siblings and the texts read.

Behaviour: buildAcceptances({cards, checks, profile, texts}). A profile other than typescript and go → {ok: false, errors: ["no acceptance builder for language '<id>' (only typescript, go)"]}. Else the errors, in this order: the guard, then the locator, holding any of the six heredoc tags (HEREDOC_TAGS: MORPH_GUARD_EOF, MORPH_CONF_EOF, MORPH_TSCONF_EOF, MORPH_FIRSTDIFF_EOF, MORPH_PROBE_EOF, MORPH_LITS_EOF) → "the guard holds the heredoc tag <tag>" / "the first-difference locator holds …", one per tag; then per checks card in order: no card of that id → "checks card '<id>' is not in the deck" (nothing more on it); no target with an extension of the profile → "card '<id>' has no <profile id> target" (a wrong profile is refused, never built); a judge (files not null) whose file paths are not exactly its targets → "judge '<id>': files <JSON of the paths> are not its targets <JSON of the targets>"; a code card without texts.probes[id] → "code card '<id>' has no probe", a probe holding a tag → "the probe of <id> holds the heredoc tag <tag>"; smoke null with a test target → "code card '<id>' targets the test <test> but has no smoke cap"; smoke with no test target → "code card '<id>' has a smoke cap but no test target". Any error → {ok: false, errors}. The members are the named cards in the checks' order; their generations are Layer Generations of the members alone (a dependency outside them is ignored); a member's siblings are the targets of the other members of its generation, in the checks' order. Each member gets Code Acceptance or Judge Acceptance — with the go profile builder-go's goCodeAcceptance or goJudgeAcceptance, same arguments — with ctx {id, phase, targets, siblings, frozen, fullExclude, ownGit, profile, guard, firstdiff, allowed, vendor} — P19: the input's optional uses (Plan Spec's, customId → declared names) and vendor (vendor/modules.txt exists), absent {} and false; allowed = uses[customId] as given when uses has that own key, else []; vendor = input.vendor === true; nothing else reads them. → {ok: true, cards}: the input cards in their order, each member a copy with its acceptance, every other card as given. probeFile(profile, id) (exported; cli reads the probe by it) = "_<id>_probe_test.go" for the go profile (the leading "_" makes the go tool ignore the file where it is kept, decks/<phase>/parts), else "<id>.probe.ts". P21 (#12): an optional hide (customId → paths) appends hide[customId] (an own key) to a member's ctx siblings and ctx fullExclude, a path already held skipped; no hide or key → as before. ## Function Run Transaction

Write every card, then run every acceptance on the full tree, retry the owners of the red lines to a fixed point, commit all or nothing.

Behaviour: runTransaction(input, deps) → Promise<Run Result>; Run Deck calls it for a deck Transaction Deck marks, before anything else (src/runloop/deck.ts: `if (isTransactionDeck(input.deck.cards)) return runTransaction(input, deps);` as its first line; import from "./transaction.js" and "../cards/transaction.js"). owners: every target of every card → its customId (deck order, the first owner kept). before = Snapshot Targets(root, every target, deck order) — the run's starting tree. W = Write: runDeck(input with deck.cards each a copy with acceptance "true", externalDependsOn as given; deps with commit () => null) — Run Deck's generations, budget, interrupts, skips and retries of a card it could not write (corrupt, truncated, stale, compile), every written answer left on the tree. W.report.fault set, or some W outcome not "written" → rollback (below), no acceptance run. Else rounds r = 0, 1, …: every card in deck order runs ITS acceptance (Run Acceptance(card.acceptance, root, {env: deps.env, timeoutMs: deps.acceptanceTimeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS})); exit 0 green, else red with Blame Log(its log, its customId, owners, TREE_PROFILES' fileLine in order, p → a file or directory exists at root/p). All green → deps.commit(id, targets) per card in deck order, id = the customId of the attempt whose files are on the tree (the card's, or "<customId>.r<n>" of its last written retry); done. Probes: per card with files null, <parts>/<builder's probeFile(profile, id)> if regular (go: _<id>_probe_test.go). → {ok: true, checks, texts: {guard, firstdiff, probes}}.

Preconditions a test's setup depends on:
- planner · Cut Component · Validate Record made the record, so every uses name is a declared dependency; a name no dependency carries is simply not found
- planner · Cut Judges · Cut Component made the cuts; an extra card is a Cut Card with component and profile null, functions [] and slicedByMap true
